key_features: Take one hassle out of back to school shopping and buy a School Supply Box filled with everything your high school student needs. This 12x10x6-inch school supply pack includes: (5) 3-prong folders, (2) packs of 100-sheet college-ruled filler paper, (4) college-ruled single-subject notebooks, (4) college-ruled composition notebooks
Additionally, the box contains (2) packs of index cards, (1) 10-pack of wooden pencils, (1) 12-pack of black pens, (1) 12-pack of red pens.
This massive school supply kit contains everything your child needs for the first day of school and beyond.
Whether it’s for homework, studying, or writing assignments, this kit is ready to go! The tools included are also great for note-taking, flashcards, and keeping organized throughout the year.
School Supply Boxes don’t have to be just for students—this kit also makes a great gift for a teacher, tutor, homeschooling family, or anyone looking to stock up on school essentials.
review_summary: Every parent has experienced the frustration of buying school supplies. Crowds and limited supplies at box stores can make it impossible to find everything on your child's school supply list quickly. Shopping early might help, but who wants to shop for school supplies in July? And if you’re one of those last minute shoppers, you often have to take what you can find no matter if it might not be the best quality. We saw this and thought there had to be a better way.
